name: Claudius Jablonka
headline: Tech VC, Entrepreneur, Angel Investor
summary:
Claudius is a Tech VC and an experienced investor and operator with a strong track record of identifying and empowering exceptional early stage founders. For more than a decade, he has created a deep network in the European and US tech ecosystem. 
 
Prior to being a GP at Volkswagen backed VC firm Leitmotif, Claudius was a Co-Founder and General Partner at 10x Founders, an early-stage venture capital firm that raised €160 million from an extraordinary network of 200 European and US angel investors. During his tenure, 10x Founders invested in 70 startups across Europe and the US – notably Cylib (battery recycling), Ixana (semiconductors) and Magic (AI foundation models). Previously, Claudius established the Munich office of Plug and Play Tech Center, where he led several deep tech and AI investments – including Recogni and Presize.ai – and successfully facilitated open innovation programs with some of Europe’s largest corporations.

As Chief of Staff at notebooksbilliger.de, one of the most successful e-commerce companies in Germany, Claudius was instrumental in scaling the organization to €800 million in annual net revenue. Claudius began his career at the Center for Digital Technology and Management (CDTM) managing an elite entrepreneurship program that included the founders of five unicorn companies – Personio, Razor, Cellares, Trade Republic and Forto. He continues to be a lecturer and advisor at CDTM. 
 
Claudius earned a doctorate in Economics and a Master of Business Research from the Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München (LMU). In his PhD thesis he researched successful internationalization strategies of startup companies. He also holds a Master’s degree in Management & Technology, with a minor in Mechanical Engineering, from the Technische Universität München (TUM), during which he spent a semester abroad at UC Berkeley.

positions.description:
CDTM is the birthplace of 25% of Germany’s unicorns. It’s not only one of the most selective educational institutions to get into, with a mere 6% acceptance rate, but it also boasts the highest "unicorn-to-alumni ratio" in the world (9 unicorns / 1,200 alumni, as of 2025). 

CDTM stands for a culture of ambition and creativity, of excellence and passion that successfully inspires outlier success in the startup ecosystem (Personio, Razor, Cellares, Trade Republic and Forto, etc.). 

I've selected, supported and coached brilliant talents who went on to become inspiring founders and leaders in diverse fields.

Since finishing my PhD in 2015, I continue to be a university guest lecturer at CDTM. Designing and teaching courses such as: "Sales, Persuasion and Influence", "Pitching to Venture Capitalists", "Emotional Leadership and Social Dynamics", "Advanced B2B Sales"
